info.name: SMemories - yearbooks
info.description: Yearbook CRUD and profile information (T-008). Run against an API started with SMEM_ENV=dev, after the auth collection's assumptions: the session token is read from the register response's Set-Cookie header and sent in an explicit Cookie header, so two users (A and B) can act in one run (an explicit header wins over Newman's cookie jar; "no session" requests send an empty smem_session). Each run registers 2 users (the register limit is 5 per hour per IP: run `make reset-limits` (the limiters live in Redis), or set SMEM_RATE_REGISTER_PER_HOUR higher, before a third run within the hour). Run the whole collection in order: the Edge cases folder reuses the users and the yearbook from the Full flow.

exec: // Folder scripts run before every request in the folder, so generate only before the first one: the whole flow then
// uses one consistent pair of accounts, and every new run gets fresh ones (no collision with data from older runs).

item.name: 3. A creates a yearbook (NFD title is stored as NFC; profile name defaults to the display name)

exec:
const b = pm.response.json().data;
pm.test('book shape', () => { pm.expect(b.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-Z]{26}$/); pm.expect(b).to.not.have.any.keys('owner_id', 'internal_id'); pm.expect(b.profile.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-Z]{26}$/); pm.expect(b.profile.is_owner).to.eql(true); });pm.test('same book', () => { pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('bookId')); pm.expect(b.profile.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('profileId')); });

item.name: 5. A lists yearbooks (only the own book)

exec: pm.test('one book, no next page', () => { pm.expect(j.data.items).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.data.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('bookId')); pm.expect(j.data.next_id).to.eql(''); });

item.name: 6. A patches the yearbook (partial; null clears the year)

exec:
const b = pm.response.json().data;
pm.test('book shape', () => { pm.expect(b.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-Z]{26}$/); pm.expect(b).to.not.have.any.keys('owner_id', 'internal_id'); pm.expect(b.profile.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-Z]{26}$/); pm.expect(b.profile.is_owner).to.eql(true); });pm.test('patched, rest kept', () => { pm.expect(b.title).to.eql('Renamed book'); pm.expect(b.motto).to.eql('Carpe diem'); pm.expect(b.graduation_year).to.eql(null); pm.expect(b.school_name).to.eql('Fake University'); pm.expect(b.page_size).to.eql('A4'); });

const b = pm.response.json().data;
pm.test('book shape', () => { pm.expect(b.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-Z]{26}$/); pm.expect(b).to.not.have.any.keys('owner_id', 'internal_id'); pm.expect(b.profile.id).to.match(/^[0-9A-Z]{26}$/); pm.expect(b.profile.is_owner).to.eql(true); });pm.test('profile replaced', () => { const p = b.profile; pm.expect(p.full_name).to.eql('Nguy\u1ec5n V\u0103n A'); pm.expect(p.nickname).to.eql('Bong'); pm.expect(p.birthday).to.eql('2004-02-29'); pm.expect(p.quote).to.eql('Stay hungry'); pm.expect(p.hobbies).to.eql(''); pm.expect(p.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('profileId')); });
pm.test('empty', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(j.data.next_id).to.eql(''); });

item.name: CSRF - delete with a session cookie from a foreign Origin - 403
CSRF - create with a session cookie and no Origin - 403
Create - 21st yearbook of one user - 409 ERROR_LIMIT_REACHED

exec: // Create 20 books for user B (sequentially, one request at a time), so the request itself is the 21st.
const one = (i) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest({
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Filler ' + i, language: 'en' }) }
}, (e, r) => (e || r.code !== 200) ? reject(e || new Error('filler ' + i + ' got ' + r.code)) : resolve()));
(async () => { for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) { await one(i); } })();
